title: Favourites and Saved searches

summary.problem: Favourites and Saved searches share one screen behind two tabs. The screens had no empty state and the saved-searches tab had no design at all.
summary.scope: Favourites and Saved searches on desktop and mobile web: the saved-ads list, the saved-searches list, and the empty state of each tab.
summary.changed: v2 adds the mobile prototype flow (Favourites tab, Saved searches tab, delete to empty state) and one open question: mobile Favourites cards have no way to un-save an ad.

signoff.meaning: layout and copy are confirmed against live before build

rules.text: The tab strip has two tabs, 'Favourites' and 'Saved searches', with no counts. The Saved searches tab is shown only when the saved-searches feature is enabled for the market.
rules.test: With the feature off, only 'Favourites' renders; with it on, both render and neither label carries a number.

rules.text: The Favourites empty state renders only when the list has loaded, contains zero ads, and is not loading. While loading, the list shows its loading placeholders instead.
rules.test: Mock a loaded empty response: 'No favorites yet.' shows. Mock a pending request: it does not.

rules.text: The Favourites empty state is a single bold line with no image and no button.
rules.test: The empty-state container has one text node and no or

rules.text: Each saved search shows its title and its filters as attribute chips, a 'View results' action and a delete action.
rules.test: Every row has exactly one 'View results' link and one button named 'Delete saved search'.

rules.text: Deleting the last saved search shows the Saved searches empty state, 'No saved searches yet.'
rules.test: Delete the only row: the list is replaced by the empty-state line.

rules.text: The Favourites and Saved searches tabs switch the list in place; the page title stays 'Favourites'.
rules.test: Click 'Saved searches': the list changes, the tab underline moves, the H1 still reads 'Favourites'.

acceptance: Tab labels match the source strings exactly: 'Favourites', 'Saved searches'.
Both empty-state strings render verbatim, including the US spelling 'favorites' in 'No favorites yet.'
edge_cases: A saved search whose title is very long truncates with an ellipsis on one line (the row never wraps the title).
A saved search with many filters wraps its chips onto further lines.

open_questions.q: Is the Saved searches tab enabled in Egypt? The monorepo gates it behind isSavedSearchesEnabled(), and the empty-state string 'No saved searches yet.' was only found in the Jordan locale.
Confirm the empty-state wording against live. 'No favorites yet.' uses US spelling next to the 'Favourites' tab label; is that intended?
What is the size of the empty-state line? The monorepo uses Text.Large, which was not measured; 2rem is a stand-in.
The saved-searches row (title, chips, View results, delete) is a proposal with no live reference. Does live have a different layout, and does delete ask for confirmation?
Mobile Favourites cards have no heart, so a saved ad cannot be un-saved from the list on mobile (desktop cards have one). Is the remove action elsewhere (card menu, swipe, or the ad page)?
open_questions.blocks: R2 on mobile (the only way to reach the empty state)

changelog.notes: Added the mobile prototype flow, a platform switch in the prototype runner, and an open question about un-saving on mobile.
First build. Favourites and Saved searches, desktop and mobile, with empty states. Copy and structure from the maple monorepo; not verified on live.
